Oblimersen Sodium (USAN, rINNM) G-3139; Natrii Oblimersenum; Oblimersén sódico; Oblimersen Sodique. Натрий Облимерсен C172H204N62-Na17O91P17S17 = 6058.3. CAS — 190977-41-4. Profile Oblimersen sodium is an antisense oligonucleotide that blocks the production of BCL-2, a mitochondrial protein that prevents apoptosis. It is under investigation for the treatment of various malignant neoplasms, including leukaemias, lung cancer, and malignant melanoma. ◊ References. 1. Frankel SR.
